title: test-map
description: governance/project/test-map.yaml: what a scoped close runs for a change (DEC-880 item 2, DEC-889 items 1 and 2, DEC-896 item 2). A changed path under the shared core, a path nothing places, and a map that is missing or invalid run the full regression.

shared_core.description: A changed path matching one of these runs the full regression (DEC-880 item 2 (a), DEC-892 c, P-IS-1 (a)).

record_only.description: Records (DEC-891's places): a matching path is placed and selects nothing by itself. No code path matches one.

record_reading.description: The tests that read a record-only path, directly or by scanning the tree: run on every close (DEC-889 item 2, P-IS-2 (a)).

every_close.description: Targets run on every close, whatever changed (P-IS-1 (a): W1-07's three contract files).

couplings.description: What imports and coverage cannot see: a changed path matching one of `paths` selects each of `suites`.

test_inputs.description: Paths that are test inputs, not records (DEC-876 item 2): moved here from the path map.

per_test_timeout.description: Seconds a single test may run under pytest-timeout's signal method (DEC-892 b); default 900.

distribution.description: The parallel run's pytest-xdist --dist mode; default load (worksteal waits, DEC-892 a).

pattern.description: allowed_paths' grammar: ** matches any characters including /, * any characters except /, the rest literal; the whole path must match.

target.description: A pytest target relative to the project: a folder, a file, or a node id or its beginning.
